evidence_scheme: Each claim not proved on the page carries one class: empirical result (paper and page), engineering check (this chapter's code or shown arithmetic), product claim (a company's or institution's statement about its own product, price or course, including course-structure statements in the recording), speaker judgment (with recording time). Definitions and results proved on the page carry no label. Each section opens with a provenance line: lecture / research extension / original construction.
running_case: y in {0,1} with probability 1/2 each; x = (2y-1) mu + chi in R^16, every coordinate of mu equal to 1/2 (||mu||_2 = 2), chi ~ N(0, I). Three least-squares linear classifiers read the first n_feat in {1, 4, 16} coordinates (2, 5, 17 parameters) and predict 1 when b + w.x > 1/2. Floors Phi(-||mu_{1:n_feat}||_2) = 0.3085, 0.1587, 0.0228 (Proposition 2). Used for ERM optimism (Proposition 1), learning curves and the capacity floor (Proposition 3, Figure 1), forecasting from four sizes (Figure 2), the gradient-descent step-size threshold (Proposition 4), a noise increase in use (code-and-data: 0-1 risk Phi(-sqrt 2) = 0.0786 against 0.0228), and exercises 4-5. Original construction. The face-verification door (thread 1) is previewed only (process section).

notation_decisions: Hestness et al.'s eps(m) = alpha m^beta_g + gamma mapped once to Err(m) = Err_irr + Lambda m^-xi (NOTATION section 2).

Running-case feature count written n_feat (k is the class index); the score is written f_theta(x) (s is the RL state).
Eigenvalues written eig_max, eig_j (lambda is the penalty coefficient; kappa is Cohen's kappa).
The input with a constant 1 prepended is x-tilde^(i) (a is the RL action).
No residual symbol in the proof of Proposition 2 (e would collide with Euler's number); no substitution variable v in the proof of Proposition 3(d).

chi used in the definition of the running case as well as in proofs (NOTATION section 5 row says 'inside a proof'); proposed extension in ch01.md.
